description: Source code for CLI commands managing execution approvals, including fetching, setting, and editing allowlists, with external dependencies on filesystem, JSON parsing, and project-specific modules.

methods.name: readStdin
methods.description: Reads all data from stdin and returns as a string.

methods.name: resolveTargetNodeId
methods.description: Resolves a node ID from CLI options, considering gateway and node input.

methods.name: loadSnapshot
methods.description: Loads an execution approvals snapshot from gateway or local storage.

methods.name: loadSnapshotLocal
methods.description: Loads a local execution approvals snapshot.

methods.name: saveSnapshotLocal
methods.description: Saves a local execution approvals snapshot.

methods.name: loadSnapshotTarget
methods.description: Determines source (local, node, gateway) and loads the corresponding snapshot.

methods.name: exitWithError
methods.description: Logs an error message and exits the process.

methods.name: requireTrimmedNonEmpty
methods.description: Ensures a string is non-empty after trimming, otherwise exits with error.

methods.name: loadWritableSnapshotTarget
methods.description: Prepares a writable snapshot target, including label and hash.

methods.name: saveSnapshotTargeted
methods.description: Saves a snapshot to local or remote target, optionally outputs JSON.

methods.name: formatCliError
methods.description: Formats an unknown error into a user-friendly message.

methods.name: loadConfigForApprovalsTarget
methods.description: Loads configuration based on target source (local or gateway).

methods.name: buildEffectivePolicyReport
methods.description: Builds a report on effective execution policy based on config and approvals.

methods.name: renderEffectivePolicy
methods.description: Renders the effective policy report to the terminal.

methods.name: renderApprovalsSnapshot
methods.description: Displays detailed information about an approvals snapshot, including allowlist entries.

methods.name: resolveAgentKey
methods.description: Resolves an agent key, defaulting to '*' if input is empty.

methods.name: normalizeAllowlistEntry
methods.description: Normalizes an allowlist entry pattern, trimming whitespace.

methods.name: ensureAgent
methods.description: Ensures an agent exists in the approvals file, creating if necessary.

methods.name: isEmptyAgent
methods.description: Checks if an agent has no security, ask, askFallback, autoAllowSkills, or allowlist.

methods.name: loadWritableAllowlistAgent
methods.description: Loads data necessary to modify an allowlist for an agent.

methods.name: runAllowlistMutation
methods.description: Runs a mutation (add/remove pattern) on the allowlist, handling errors.

methods.name: registerAllowlistMutationCommand
methods.description: Registers CLI commands for adding or removing allowlist patterns.

methods.name: registerExecApprovalsCli
methods.description: Registers the main CLI commands for managing execution approvals.
